energy/carbon cost of quantized inference poorly quantified | 10 PTQ strategies x 5 models x 4 GPUs across GLUE/MMLU/HumanEval/GSM8K; peak efficiency at long-input/short-output, fused int8 up to 4x energy savings — energy evaluation, accuracy a secondary note

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: contracted memories (skills, caches, templates) quietly answer wrong after facts change | counter-based change-detection theory (power-of-horizon delay) + likelihood-ratio certified memories; five LLMs, ExpeL/ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x (35-73x on code) more stale answers

frontier-model cost for every long-horizon agent step | step-level RL delegation of critical steps to a cloud LLM (EdgeWise); matches full-LLM execution at up to 62% lower cost on SWE-Rebench — cost optimization, no reliability angle

Muon RMS proxy misjudges softmax output-distribution change | Hilbert-distance constrained steepest descent unifying RowNorm and Compositional Muon — optimizer theory, no training-run stability or observability claim

3DGS codecs give users no control over per-primitive distortion | training-free error-bounded codec translating four tolerances into per-primitive quantization bounds (PLEDGE); thirteen scenes, all declared bounds verified, competitive rate-distortion

wrong or stale model-based verifiers corrupt training-free self-improvement loops | co-evolved executable verifier programs selected by driving capacity on response contrasts (UCoE); 59.00%/57.19% preference on six open-ended benchmarks with Qwen3-8B/Qwen3.8-27B

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: scattered interaction state disconnects long-horizon coding edits from their consequences | runtime state harness with affected-artifact search and diagnostic sessions (StateHarness); RefactorBench 29.4->35.3%, LHTB 0.427->0.576, ChainSWE 35.1->39.5% with regression trade-offs reported

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits

judge-marked first-mistake labels point at symptoms not causes | executable prefix values with certified point-of-no-return on 150 SWE-bench Verified tasks; judges agree on exact step 21/57, restart at measured point raises success 0.44->0.57 vs -0.08 at labels

quantized-pretraining loss mispredicted by existing precision scaling laws | capacity/optimization-error-separating mixed-precision law fitted on Qwen3 4-bit regimes + published Llama-style runs; up to 11x lower MSE, layer-wise recipe optimization under compute budgets
